items.before: Recovery dialog could return focus to a notice obscured by fixed navigation.
items.after: Reveal the focused notice within header and bottom-navigation safe bounds without resetting filters or submitting again.

items.before: Archive history occupied a generic banner on client and team workflows.
items.after: Contextual expandable history keeps the existing archive option available.

items.before: Long client placeholder crowded narrow project forms.
items.after: Use a short Choose a client prompt.

items.before: Required project basics and optional start date were unclear.
items.after: Mark required basics and explicitly identify optional start date.

items.before: Timezone entry required knowing an exact identifier.
items.after: Offer common timezone suggestions while keeping unrestricted valid custom entry.

items.before: Nested mobile project form borders reduced usable input width.
items.after: Remove redundant phone inset and border.

items.before: Phone task launcher covered form actions.
items.after: Keep task finder accessible from section navigation and remove its floating phone overlay.

items.before: Workspace breadcrumb had a small touch target.
items.after: Give the home breadcrumb a 44px target.

items.before: Eight search suggestions lengthened ordinary Tab navigation.
items.after: Keep arrow-key suggestion navigation with suggestions outside sequential Tab order.

items.before: Search result changes were not announced.
items.after: Announce result count and empty result state.

items.before: Invoice links repeated indistinguishable draft labels.
items.after: Include project, service period and short identity in invoice link names.

items.before: Billing stream action names repeated without context.
items.after: Identify project, stream and effective date in stream action names.

items.before: Expense classification links repeated Open expense.
items.after: Identify worker, date, amount and record in expense link names.

items.before: Person configuration and save actions lacked worker context.
items.after: Name the worker in each configuration and save action.

items.before: Ledger timelines had identical link names.
items.after: Name invoice and client in timeline disclosure.

items.before: Accounting format links were indistinguishable between packs.
items.after: Include pack period and creation context in download link names.

items.before: Accounting PDF preview actions lacked pack identity.
items.after: Add pack context to PDF preview action names.

items.before: Accounting review controls repeated without context.
items.after: Identify each review and finalization area by pack.

items.before: Accounting secondary links and issuer remedies were hard to tap and distinguish.
items.after: Provide 44px actions and contextual issuer remedy names.

items.before: Invoice preview lacked an H1, document-specific browser title and named navigation.
items.after: Expose invoice and project identity in the heading and title, with named invoice navigation.

items.before: Inline invoice editing targets were only text-sized.
items.after: Use 44px editing controls on screen while retaining print rendering.

items.before: Invoice editing exposed raw internal field names.
items.after: Translate issuer, client and company field labels.

items.before: Two invoice-number edit buttons had identical names.
items.after: Distinguish heading and details number controls.

items.before: Invoice source and rebuild guidance links were small on phones.
items.after: Make source-setting and rebuild actions large and stackable.

items.before: Localized PDF controls were below comfortable touch size.
items.after: Use 44px selects, buttons and text actions.

items.before: Invoice Back navigation dropped language.
items.after: Carry current language back to billing.

items.before: Finance calculation navigation dropped language.
items.after: Carry current language to calculation detail.

items.before: Commercial agreement preview dropped language.
items.after: Carry current language to agreement preview.

items.before: Review terms GET form dropped language.
items.after: Preserve language when reviewing dated terms.

items.before: Finance source and reimbursement links dropped language.
items.after: Preserve language through work-source and reimbursement navigation.

items.before: Accounting remedy navigation dropped language.
items.after: Keep current locale and existing record context on accounting remedies.

items.before: Direct invoice period entry remained English in Spanish and Portuguese.
items.after: Localize the direct-period disclosure.

items.before: Final and stale accounting filter values appeared as raw state names.
items.after: Localize displayed filter labels without changing stored values.

items.before: New accounting exports defaulted to English regardless of portal language.
items.after: Default report language to current locale and preserve failed submission choices.

items.before: Focused skip link briefly remained offscreen during animation.
items.after: Show skip link immediately on focus.

items.before: Section chooser did not mark current section.
items.after: Expose current section with aria-current and visible active state.

items.before: Commercial rules required a long scroll past expense classification.
items.after: Add local shortcuts to expense treatment and commercial configuration.

items.before: Each accounting pack repeated long secondary workflows inline.
items.after: Keep every export format’s queued, processing, ready or failed status and ready downloads visible; group secondary controls in an optional disclosure, with current failures and recovery notices revealed automatically.

items.before: Accounting articles lacked period headings and accessible names.
items.after: Name each article through its period heading.

items.before: Auditors lacked clear access-mode guidance across finance views.
items.after: Show read-only guidance on finance, ledger and accounting.
